pyStarburst99: stellar population synthesis in Python

pyStarburst99 is a Python translation and update of the Starburst99 Fortran code. It predicts the integrated properties of star-forming galaxies from evolutionary tracks and stellar spectral libraries.

Key features

  • Instantaneous burst (ISF) and continuous star formation (CSF) models.

  • Seven metallicities, from the Milky Way centre (Z = 0.02) to Z = 0.

  • GENEC (rotating and non-rotating) and MESA (Pauli+2026) evolutionary tracks, with stars up to 300–500 M\(_\odot\).

  • Fastwind, WMbasic and PoWR OB stellar libraries, plus Wolf-Rayet and low-mass star spectra.

  • Outputs: SEDs, high-resolution UV spectra, ionising fluxes, bolometric luminosity, wind power and momentum, hydrogen line equivalent widths, UV slopes, colours and supernova rates.

Quick start

import pystarburst99

# Select model and output folder
metallicity = 'IZw18'  #MWC, MW, LMC, SMC, IZw18, XMP and Z0
output_folder = './pyStarburst99_grids'

# Create model compiler
sb99 = pystarburst99.Compiler(output_folder=f'{output_folder}/{metallicity}_grids',
                              Z=metallicity, track_choice='GENEC', rotation=False,
                              SED_library='FW', spectra_library='WM', star_formation_option='ISF',
                              log_age_start=6.0, log_age_end=8.0, log_age_step=0.1, log_intervals=True,
                              beta_tools=True, overwrite_results=True)

# Run the track computations and grid interpolation
pop = sb99.population_synthesis()

# Save the results (previous folder content is deleted)
sb99.save_results()

The inputs not provided take their values from the [default_settings] section of pystarburst99.toml.

Model options

Input

Options

Description

Z

MWC, MW, LMC, SMC, IZw18, XMP, Z0

Metallicity: 0.02, 0.014, 0.006, 0.002, 0.0004, 1e-5 and 0

star_formation_option

ISF, CSF

Instantaneous burst (M_total) or continuous star formation (SFR)

track_choice

GENEC, Pauli

GENEC or MESA (Pauli+2026) evolutionary tracks

rotation

True, False

GENEC tracks with 0.4 vcrit rotation

SED_library

FW, WM, PoWR

Low-resolution OB library for the SEDs and ionising fluxes

spectra_library

WM, PoWR

High-resolution OB library for the UV line profiles

IMF_exponents, IMF_mass_limits

e.g. [1.3, 2.3], [0.1, 0.5, 120]

Power-law IMF (Kroupa by default)

run_speed_mode

FAST, DEFAULT, HIGH_RES

Resolution of the isochrone mass interpolation
